steps.content: The fog in the street gradually dissipates, but the gloomy weather remains suffocating.

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: Wh-who's there? Shears, st-stay away! Ahhhh!
In the darkness of night, you hear bloodcurdling screams all over the alley—people are begging the real Mad Shears to stop.
It's too late. As the shears gleam, the monsters made of worries disappear, and so does Adela. Yet you bump into another woman head-on.
She stands in the middle of the street in a daze. You've seen her before. It's the "Mad Shears" who had been controlled by the shears. The cursed hair entangling her had disappeared without a trace.
She now has an eerie, nonchalant smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: I get it, I get it. You're better than me, braver and stronger and more hardworking... You're all awesome. Everyone's better than me.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Hehe... It doesn't matter. Even so, I have nothing to envy. Nothing at all.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Mad Shears made my wish come true. Mad Shears severed all my worries. I won't worry anymore. I don't need to try anymore. I'm worthless, yay...
You look up and see a flickering lantern not far away. It seems a bit scared, hanging back but still close by.

options: ...I still have urgent matters to attend to.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: When this is all over, I'll come back to see you. Take care.

steps.speaker: Mad Shears
steps.content: Hehe, why work so hard... I was so stupid back then, hehe... so stupid...
Another scream rings out in the distance.
